授業概要
日本を含む東アジア地域の自然環境とその成り立ち、およびこれらの地域の防災・資源利用・生物多様性・環境変動を対象に、地理学・生物学・地球科学・水文学・環境学を統合する学際的な研究手法の基礎について野外実習等を通じて学びます。
Students will learn the fundamentals of interdisciplinary research methods that integrate geography, biology, earth science, hydrology, and environmental studies, through field work, etc., on the natural environment and its formation process of East Asia, including Japan, as well as disaster prevention, natural resource uses, biodiversity, and environmental changes in the region.

授業形態
（内容）
事前講義では調査地についてグループ単位で調査・発表します．現地巡検では教員や現地案内者により解説を行います．In the preparatory lecture, students will work in groups to research the study area and present their findings. During the field excursion, explanations will be provided by the instructor and local guides.

全体の教育目標
日本を含む東アジア地域の自然環境とその成り立ち、およびこれらの地域の防災・資源利用・生物多様性・環境変動を対象について、地理学・生物学・地球科学・水文学・環境学を統合する学際的な観点から分析する力の獲得を目指します．This course aims to develop the ability to analyze the natural environment of East Asia, including Japan, its formation processes, and issues related to disaster risk reduction, resource use, biodiversity, and environmental change, from an interdisciplinary perspective integrating geography, biology, earth science, hydrology, and environmental studies.
